author: Mark Atwood
text: Security pass on the 2ehk follow-up batch (kimi-k3) adds concrete clobber vectors beyond the suppression vector already noted: (a) fixed-name redirect 2>"$STATE/fleet_burn.err" follows a planted symlink and truncates an arbitrary user-writable file every cycle (e.g. ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json -> credential destruction) — no pid guessing needed; (b) burn-snapshot.json.<pid>.tmp follows pre-planted symlinks (pid-range spray cheap); os.replace itself is safe (replaces the link, not the target). The rmza self-heal (dir recreated when tmpfiles cleans) widens the recreate-window. Prereq: local unprivileged account on the guard host (latent on current single-user hosts). Fix: state under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/fleet-driver, or install -d -m 700 + owner verify, and os.open tmp with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW.
